audience: quality and compliance teams that run document control, quality events and training in Qualio

useCases.title: See which documents wait for review
useCases.text: Query documents by status, for example those for review. Open one to read its owners, reviewers and approvers.

useCases.title: Track the open quality events you own
useCases.text: Find your own user id, then list the open quality events with you as owner. Open one by its code, such as CAPA-12.

useCases.title: Check overdue training on SOP revisions
useCases.text: List the training assignments that are overdue, filtered by document id or group. Read the company training statistics for a period.

useCases.title: Review supplier approvals and compliance gaps
useCases.text: List suppliers by approval status. List compliance gaps by framework, status or severity.

useCases.title: Open a quality event from a template
useCases.text: List the event templates, then create a quality event from one. Others see the record, so confirm the title first.
